source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: Cozy futuristic pharmacogenomics laboratory office interior at night, photorealistic cinematic 3D render, wide interior view. In the center foreground, a brushed dark metal table reflecting warm light, with an open spiral-bound notebook on a brown leather cover on the left side of the table, handwritten text on the right page reading "CYP3A4 Interaction Risk" and a black and gold fountain pen resting on it, smaller handwritten notes on the left page unreadable, and on the right side of the table a white cracked-marble coffee cup with a teal silicone lid on a matching saucer. Floating in the center above the table, a glowing translucent teal DNA double helix hologram with gold spherical nodes connected to a molecular structure below it, emitting cyan light. On the left wall, a large vertical floating holographic display with cyan neon border, title text at the top reading "EvidenceGrade AI", below it "5-tier grade" with five stacked colored bars labeled "A" in green, "B" in teal-blue, "C" in yellow, "D" in orange, and "F" in pink-red, and on the right side of the display a line graph titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with y-axis 0 to 60 and a rising cyan line, caption below reading "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". In the center background, white wall shelves with small brown amber medicine bottles with white labels reading "Aspirin", "Warfarin", and "Ibuprofen", binders, test tubes, a brass vintage microscope on a counter below, and a potted monstera plant with green leaves and one yellow leaf in a white textured pot. On the right, a large arched multi-pane window looking out onto a rainy cyberpunk city street at night with wet reflections and glowing pink, red, and cyan neon signs with Chinese characters, most text unreadable, rain droplets on glass; on the windowsill a black cat silhouette sitting and looking outside, and a closed red umbrella with a curved dark handle leaning against the wall below. Warm cozy interior lighting contrasting with cool blue and neon pink exterior light, reflective surfaces, detailed materials, atmospheric, high detail.
